name: clarus-agent
description: A Claude Code / Codex-style coding agent panel, guarded by ClarusGuard (structural injection defense + human approval on every side effect).

clarusAgent.provider.description: LLM backend used for the agent loop.

clarusAgent.anthropicModel.description: Model id used when provider = anthropic.

clarusAgent.openaiModel.description: Model id used when provider = openai.

clarusAgent.anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key (or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var instead).

clarusAgent.openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key (or set OPENAI_API_KEY env var instead).

clarusAgent.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the ClarusGuard bridge (server/vscode_bridge.py).

clarusAgent.guardRepoPath.description: Path to the clarus-agent-guard directory (defaults to the folder bundled with this extension).
